messages:
alex: Morning all — quick async standup for content rollout.

alex: What I did: finalized hero copy for launch page, ran one more aria test.

alex: Blockers: waiting on final A/B image from design; need a quick perf check on embed pipeline.

alex: Today: ship copy into CMS, ping infra for embedding job, review PR #428

mira: Done yesterday: uploaded 5 SEO drafts to the calendar, set publish windows.

mira: Blockers: the tracking params we agreed on aren't in the GTM ticket.

mira: Today: add UTM params, loop in @vincent for analytics event mapping.

sam: Quick CR ping — I've left comments on PR #428 (content/cms update). @alex can you check the CTA copy?

vincent: Ack — I'll map analytics. Can we standardize event names to "content.publish" etc?

vincent: Also noticed the embed job spikes CPU on small instances. @rachel any deployment windows today?

rachel: We have a maintenance window 16:00-17:00 PT; don't deploy heavy jobs then.

rachel: I can schedule a low-priority rolling deploy at 18:30 PT. :calendar: 

alex: Noted re: window. I'll wait for the image asset then kick the deploy at 18:30.

sam: For QA — here's the checklist snippet I used:

```
- verify headline renders on mobile
- check canonical tags
- confirm UTM parameters on CTA
- smoke embed job for 100 items
```

mira: Also adding a note: benchmark post is queued for 2pm tomorrow — needs final screenshot + token cost estimate.

alex: Token cost estimate — @vincent can you rough that out? We need to decide on 8k vs 4k context.

vincent: Quick calc: 8k ~ 1.9x token cost vs 4k. If screenshots are the only big token use, 4k looks fine.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/embeds-job - scheduled 2026-03-18T18:30:00Z by rachel

alex: Thanks. If no other blockers I'll merge PR after Mira adds UTMs.

mira: On it — added UTMs and pushed. PR updated.

sam: LGTM. I'm going to approve the PR now. :thumbsup: 

alex: Approved/merging. Will watch logs for first 15 mins.

vincent: I'll keep an eye on ingestion metrics and flag any token spikes.

rachel: I'll hold pager rotation during the rolling deploy in case of noisy alerts.

alex: Great — that's it for me. Ping if anything changes. :rocket:
